I am a young man farming my own small piece of land here in the middle belt. Maize is my main crop this season, and I know fertilizer helps it grow well, so I will try to buy at least one bag of NPK and maybe a little urea if I can afford it. I have no schooling and no extra money for improved seed or pesticide, so I will save seed from last year and weed by hand with my family. I cannot irrigate — I depend on the rains like everyone here.
